series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 すると 'and then, thereupon'; also 'in that case' for a conclusion drawn from what was said.
N3 そうすると 'having done that, then'; treated as one answer class with すると.
N3 その結果 'as a result'.
N3 そこで 'so, accordingly', an action taken in response to the situation.
N3 ところが 'however', a result contrary to expectation.
N3 ところで 'by the way', changing the topic.
N3 では／それでは／じゃあ 'well then, in that case'.
N3 さて 'well, now', moving on to the next topic or the main business.
N3 つまり 'in short, in other words'.
N3 即ち／すなわち 'that is, namely', formal.
N3 あるいは 'or; or possibly'; tagged formal.
N3 前者は〜後者は 'the former ... the latter'.
N3 第一 'first (point), to begin with'; article mention only.

supplementarySources.supports: Row statuses for rows 18, 19, 26, 27, 31, 67, 90, 111, 113, 114, 157, 165, 168 and 203 (all NEWL except 168 REC).

dispositions.note: Merged with そうすると into one answer class (both accepted on every item): next event, instruction outcome and drawn conclusion, against その結果 and そこで. Also accepted as an additional correct option on the three その結果 items, where it presents the result as what followed.
Same answer class as すると (row 18); accepted wherever すると is, without an instruction note; the instruction item uses the そうすると sense.
Against its look-alike ところで; expectation (思っていた／言っていた) then contrary result, including a pleasant surprise.

Against ところが (look-alike group: spoken asides and a written email turn) and against さて／では (topic-moves group: an aside question and passed-on news). Also an additional correct option on the letter item, where letter guides list it beside さて.
One answer class; では, それでは, じゃあ, じゃ, それじゃあ, それじゃ accepted. Responses and a wrap-up.
Result of what the first sentence describes (good and bad), against そこで; すると is also accepted on these items as an additional correct option.
Deliberate step taken to deal with a stated problem; no prompt uses そこ as a place word.
Formal letter transition (ところで also accepted there) and narrative transitions; opening/announcement contexts where では also fits are avoided.

Summing up, restating the other person's point and asking for a restatement, against あるいは. すなわち is shown as an additional correct option on every つまり item (register tendency only), and つまり is also accepted on すなわち items.
Formal apposition of two expressions for the same thing and a sentence-initial restatement of a whole statement; 即ち accepted; つまり shown as an additional correct option.
Additive また (two items with 〜も, one without), against あるいは. 又 accepted.
Alternatives between nouns and between 〜か clauses, and 'or possibly' after a guess; against また and against つまり／すなわち.
Lexical (第一に, 第一 'above all'); explained in the article only. No closed-choice contrast in this set would make it decidable.
One slot per item so the pair is never printed; the choice is decided by meaning.

groups.reason: Sentence-to-sentence linking of what follows extends the clause-linking material.
Discourse connectives used in conversation and narration.
Conversation management: changing topic, moving on, responding.
Restating what was said belongs with explanations and conversation.
Adding and offering alternatives sits next to listing.
Referring back to listed items sits next to listing.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN after reconciliation; RTC-A-04 and RTC-A-06 closed by coordinator decision after three rounds

findings.claim: すると was rejected as a distractor on elapsed time, but it is also natural.
findings.change: すると became an additionalCorrectOptions entry; すると／そうすると are accepted answers; the elapsed-time claim was removed.

findings.claim: ところで was rejected, but letter guides list it as a topic opener too.
findings.change: ところで became an additionalCorrectOptions entry and an accepted answer; the article notes it.

findings.claim: すなわち was rejected on register alone.
findings.change: すなわち／即ち accepted as an additional option.

findings.claim: その結果 rationales made categorical duration claims; a discovery can be read as the outcome of opening the box.
findings.change: Rationales made descriptive; after round 3 suruto-box-letter was dropped. すると keeps walk-rain, meeting-five and button-screen; the result relationship keeps 9 keys.

findings.claim: Kana answers ぜんしゃ／こうしゃ were rejected.
The では distractor rationale claimed facts about the speaker's intention that the prompt does not establish.
findings.change: Prompt-grounded rationale: では／じゃあ presents the next remark as following from what was just said or as the next step after a stage is wrapped up; the new question does not follow, so じゃあ would be a non sequitur; ところで turns to an unrelated topic.

findings.claim: すなわち was a distractor but is also correct.
findings.change: すなわち／即ち accepted as an additionalCorrectOptions entry; base options are つまり and あるいは; on the すなわち items つまり is accepted in turn.

findings.claim: Direction glosses gave the key away.
findings.change: The prompt names 涼しい北海道 and 暑い沖縄; glosses are place names only.

findings.claim: Items shared keys, leaving too few distinct keys.
findings.change: New items tokorode-email-meeting (key email-turn) and tokorode-heat-wedding.

findings.claim: Three items shared the key apposition.
Keys were item-specific rather than shared meanings.
A '(そうすると also accepted)' note on every item hinted at the すると key in typed mode.
findings.change: The note was removed from all 10 items; the instruction is 'Insert only すると, その結果 or そこで.'

findings.claim: この度 and おります needed glosses; the English was unclear.
findings.change: Glosses added; English rewritten in the item and the article.

findings.claim: The reading of 六十点 was wrong.
The English did not reflect さて.
The typed instruction did not name the candidates.
findings.change: The instruction names すると, その結果 and そこで; kanji variants remain accepted.
